messages:
alex: quick RFC follow-up — we still haven't settled on who should emit the final 'evict' for partial canaries. central controller, per-shard runtime, or a small quorum?
nora: leaning quorum model. more robust than single runtime but faster than fully central. can be local shards voting + controller tie-break.
kai: quorum makes sense but increases complexity. question: how do we define the voting unit? host, shard, or request-bucket?
selena: suggest vote unit = shard (affinity group). each shard reports a compact vote vector: {ok_count, bad_count, p95_ms, seq}. controller aggregates.
alex: we need to protect against noisy shards causing global evict. propose hierarchical quorum: local shard veto => only affects that shard (local eviction). controller quorum required for global evict.
nora: also consider probabilistic eviction to reduce oscillation. instead of instant flip, use confidence interval on error_rate and only flip when lower_bound > threshold with alpha=0.01. that prevents small-sample panic.
kai: good call. implementation sketch: compute Wilson score lower bound for error rate per-shard, require global aggregate lower bound > global_threshold and sample_count>min_n.
selena: UX: expose "confidence" in Console when recommending evict. PMs want a one-line reason: e.g., "Global evict recommended (error LB=12.3% > 10% threshold; samples=2.4k)".
fallbackbot: canary: exp-1769004321 started size=3% region=us-west :seedling:
alex: manifest suggestion (compact):
```yaml
fallback:
  ownership: hybrid
  local_scope: shard
  global_quorum: 0.66
  min_samples_global: 500
  confidence_alpha: 0.01
  local_hard_thresholds:
    error_rate_pct: 25
    p95_latency_ms: 5000
  reconciliation_ttl_s: 40
```

nora: tradeoffs: quorum avoids single-bug disasters but adds more telemetry hops. keep compact fingerprinting (delta-only) and sampling to stay under 1KB/min/canary.
kai: tie-breaker rules: if controller sees mixed votes and cannot reach quorum within TTL, prefer safe option: soft-fallback (route new sessions away) not hard-evict. avoid killing in-flight without clear consensus.
selena: on oscillation: require consecutive windows > threshold OR monotonic trend (n windows with increasing lower bound). add cooldown after flip (default 10m).
alex: security: votes and controller decisions must be signed; runtimes reject unsigned overrides. audit log must include vote_fingerprint + decision_reason.
nora: tests: add scenario "n noisy shards" where 1 shard spikes but global should hold. assert only local shard soft-evicts and controller doesn't global-evict. also test central outage where local hard-thresholds must still protect safety.
kai: dev notes: runtime exposes /v1/vote and /v1/decision-log. controller POSTs /v1/override with signed envelope. keep overrides idempotent and include decision_id.
selena: action items: 1) draft quorum proto + vote fingerprint schema @kai, 2) manifest PR w/ confidence fields @alex, 3) Console mockups for confidence badges @nora, 4) chaos tests for noisy-shard case @selena.
